title: Intune role assigned to a group with no members

report.title: {Items.Count} role {Plural(Items.Count, 'assignment targets', 'assignments target')} an empty group

messages.businessImpact: The assignment does nothing, and it hides whether the delegation it represents was ever completed or has been quietly undone.
remediation: Add the intended members, or remove the assignment.
messages.cannotSee: An assignment whose groups would not answer for their membership. It is left out rather than counted as empty. A role Graph would not name is still listed, with its type shown as not identified.
